A-Train is running: look for the "A" icon in the menu bar. Click it (or open A-Train from Launchpad) for the dashboard.

First time: click Connect VPN, enter your VPN password once, and it is kept in your Keychain.

Guide with the how-it-works, revert and troubleshooting steps: ~/VPN-docs/GUIDE.md

A-Train. Made out of frustration, so you don’t have to be.
